description:
Detailed performance for one prompt (one question Refora asks the AI models on a schedule): visibility over time, per-model visibility and answers, and the URLs cited in its answers.

Use this tool when the user asks about a specific prompt -- phrases like 'how are we doing on the prompt about X', 'details on this prompt', or as drill-down after seeing prompts from get_competitor_visibility_gap.

Name the prompt by its text: the full text as another Refora tool returned it, or a distinctive part of it. Prompts with the same text are one question and are measured together. If several prompts match, the response lists them so the user can pick.

Example: 'How are we doing on the prompt about enterprise CRM?'

days.description: How many days back to look, counted back from end_date (default today). Default 30, max 90. Ignored when start_date is given. Prompts are re-run on a schedule, so a window shorter than a week can be empty.
days.title: Days

end_date.description: Optional end of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today. Cannot be in the future.
end_date.title: End Date

prompt_text.description: The prompt's text, exactly as another Refora tool returned it, or a distinctive part of it. Matched case-insensitively.
prompt_text.title: Prompt Text

start_date.description: Optional explicit start of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). A full ISO datetime is accepted and its date is used. Overrides days.
start_date.title: Start Date

workspace_id.description: The workspace's numeric id, as returned by list_workspaces.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: get_prompt_performance
title: Prompt performance
